domain: 结构可靠度与随机分析
definition_zh: 施加逐步增大的竖向荷载评估抗倒塌能力的分析。
usage_overview: 用于评估移柱后结构的承载响应与抗连续倒塌能力，通过逐步增加竖向荷载或施加逐步增大的竖向位移，考察结构在竖向作用增大过程中的承载表现。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: The analytical model of considered structures was generated using displacement-based fiber elements to simulate frame structural components and an appropriate macro model to simulate masonry infills and subjected to pushdown analysis to assess the anti-collapse capacity of the structures.
The proposed framework for the reliability and sensitivity analyses is mainly composed of the proposed method and pushdown analysis, as illustrated in Fig. 1.
